rationale: Share-link E2E coverage exists only for Logs, Metrics, and Dashboards — no RUM surface is covered. This feature adds a ShareButton to five RUM views plus two keyboard shortcuts, so it needs its own spec in the RUM area. The on-disk directory is uppercase `RUM` (run-context spec_path says `Rum` but `ls` confirms `RUM/`), and the spec must be appended to the existing `RUM` shard in ci_matrix.json. The closest reusable pattern for data setup is rum-page-dataflow.spec.js (SDK fixture ingestion + serial mode).
